WhatIsDocCy.title: More than a scheduling tool: Your Digital Command Center

agenda.title: Smart Online Agenda
agenda.body: The most intuitive medical scheduling software. Fully customizable: define your own hours, breaks, slot durations, and booking rules. Accessible from any device.

storefront.title: Premium Digital Storefront
storefront.body: Your professional profile is your new website—live in minutes. Optimized to showcase your specialty, photo, and the languages you speak to easily connect with Cyprus's expat and local patient mix.

shield.title: The Schedule Shield
shield.body: Block the chaos before it starts. The platform flags conflicts in real time and lets you visually manage all pending requests before they ever enter your workday.

Challenges.eyebrow: SOLVING THE CHAOS OF PHONE-BASED BOOKING

visibility.title: Get found by new patients online
visibility.body: Your professional profile on DocCy is highly optimized for local Google searches. Patients filter by specialty, location, and language, view your real-time availability, and request their slot in just a few clicks.

productivity.title: Stop letting your practice feel like a call center
productivity.body: Every phone call you answer during patient care is a lost moment of focus. With DocCy, you shift your phone traffic to the screen. Your staff spends zero time repeating available slots, allowing them to focus entirely on the patients in the room.

weekendShield.title: Never miss a patient when your clinic is closed
weekendShield.body: Clinics in Cyprus close evenings, weekends, and lunch breaks. We provide scripts and strategies so patients calling on a Saturday can book online autonomously. Your team arrives Monday morning to an organized dashboard, not a chaotic list of missed calls.

profile.title: Create your profile
profile.body: Define your medical specialties, languages, and specific booking rules.

requests.title: Manage requests
requests.body: Review incoming appointment requests with full context (patient details and reason for consultation) and confirm with one click.

sync.title: Total synchronization
sync.body: Once approved, visits are automatically synced with your preferred Google or iOS Calendar.

FAQ.heading: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.intro: Straight answers to what most professionals ask before they join.

doubleBookings.question: Will using DocCy create double bookings or extra work?
doubleBookings.answer1: Not at all. DocCy acts as your single source of truth. When you or your secretary take a phone call, you simply add it manually to your DocCy panel in 5 seconds. The slot is instantly blocked on your public profile, acting as a digital shield for your schedule.

patientHabit.question: How do I get my current patients to start using this online system?
patientHabit.answer1: It is easier than you think. DocCy includes Practice Promotion tools: you can print a custom QR code for your reception desk or share your professional booking link via WhatsApp. Your patients will gladly embrace the freedom to book whenever they want.

setupTime.question: How long does it take to set up? I am very busy.
setupTime.answer1: Less than 5 minutes. DocCy is built to be plug-and-play. Furthermore, as a Founding Member, you get Personalized Onboarding: we can guide you via a quick video call or, if your practice is located in the Paphos area, we can visit your clinic in person to handle the entire setup and calendar sync for you.
